content.title: U.S. Postal Inspectors: The Federal Agents You've NEVER Heard Of
content.text: Use our link https://aura.com/generaldischarge to get a 14 day risk free trial and see if your personal information has been leaked online. Thanks to Aura for sponsoring this video! The U.S. Postal Inspection Service is the primary federal law enforcement agency for the U.S. Postal Service. If you rob a mailman, send some illegal drugs through the mail, or you open someone else’s mail… the Postal Inspectors will have the authority to investigate you. The Postal Inspectors are the primary law enforcement arm of the agency that are on par with special agents, but they don’t share that title; instead, they’re known as Postal Inspectors. If you’d like to learn more about the Postal Inspection Service’s Postal Inspectors, including what they do, how they do things, and what it takes to become a U.S. Postal Inspector, watch this video!
